title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Drill Bug Pharaoh's Servant PSV-078 Common / Short Print Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features the Earth attribute and a Common rarity. The card's name is Drill Bug and it belongs to the Pharaoh's Servant set. It is an Effect card with Card Number PSV-078 and a Defense/Toughness of 200. The card is manufactured by Konami and has a 1st Edition feature. 

The card is perfect for collectors and players of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game. It is a great addition to any collection or deck. The card's creature/monster type is Insect and it has an attack/power of 1100. This card is a must-have for any fan of the game and is sure to impress.
